verdict.rationale: Gitea provides first-party automation surfaces: an official go-sdk, the tea CLI, an API, and an action runner for its GitHub Actions-compatible CI. These directly support scripted, non-UI use, but the evidence shows nothing about how tea or the API behave non-interactively inside a CI job. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/token authentication for headless use, CLI flags or machine-readable output for scripting, documented examples of driving Gitea from CI pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions.
